title: Mail license

system.licenseBody: Internal MepMail license for your own operation, without a paid subscription. Sending, receiving and mailbox access are configured separately.
system.admissionUnavailable: New mailbox creation is unavailable in the current state
system.includedSummary: {storage} storage and {messages, number} recipients per mailbox / operational cycle
system.includedUnlimitedSummary: {storage} per mailbox · no monthly sending cap
system.resourceLimitsBody: Messages, attachments and drafts use mailbox storage. Internal use keeps technical message limits, provider capacity and abuse protections. Each address needs sending and receiving configured.
system.internalUsageActiveBody: Internal use is active without a monthly sending cap or commercial renewal. Infrastructure usage continues to be measured.
system.cycleActiveBody: The current usage policy is active. This cycle controls the sending allowance; it does not expire your System license or renew automatically.
system.cycleInactiveBody: The internal usage policy is unavailable. Check the resource configuration before sending or receiving new messages. Your System license does not expire and stored messages remain accessible according to your permissions.

loadError: The license could not be loaded. Refresh before continuing.
equalPrice: Mail is purchased per mailbox at the same price for people and agents: on its own, or at a discount with a paid Send plan.
includedSummary: {storage} and {messages, number} recipients per mailbox / period
existingLicenseBody: This team already has a registered Mail license. Use the available actions below to manage a subscription. Internal licenses are managed by the installation owner.
existingBody: This team already has a recorded Mail purchase and the license is awaiting confirmation. Refresh the status. If it remains pending, contact the installation operator; do not open another subscription.
recoveryBody: A purchase was started under earlier terms. It must be resolved before a new subscription.
adminBody: Only the team owner or an administrator can subscribe when purchasing is available. Suspended teams cannot purchase.
sendingPlanRequiredBody: This team needs an active paid Send plan to purchase Mail, increase mailboxes or resume renewal. You can still review your Mail contract, reduce mailboxes, cancel renewal, and read or export stored messages according to your access.
unavailableBody: Purchasing through the dashboard is not available in this installation yet. Ask the installation operator for the terms to enable a Mail license. Prices and allowances must be approved before purchasing.
subscriptionsPausedBody: New Mail subscriptions are paused while we switch our email delivery provider. You can subscribe as soon as we reopen.
recoveryReads: Stored messages remain available for reading and export by people with access to the mailbox.
quantityHint: From 1 to 10,000 mailboxes. A person or agent uses one mailbox each.
quantityLocked: This purchase's quantity has been preserved. Trying again checks the same purchase.
checkoutTerms: Review the final amount and terms in Stripe's secure checkout before confirming.
pendingBody: The purchase is pending confirmation. Check again with the same quantity. If it remains pending, it requires assistance; do not start another purchase.
checkoutError: This purchase expired. Refresh the status before trying again.
confirmationHint: Opening checkout or returning from it does not activate the license. Access changes only after service confirmation.
awaitingConfirmation: You returned from checkout. Wait for license confirmation and refresh the status whenever you wish.
confirmed: The service confirms that the license is active.
cancelScheduled: Renewal canceled. Current access continues until {date}.
reductionScheduled: {count, number} mailboxes scheduled for renewal on {date}; the current quantity remains available until then.
increasePending: The increase to {count, number} mailboxes is awaiting confirmed payment. Current seats remain unchanged.
managementTerms: Increases release mailboxes only after confirmed payment. Reductions apply at the next renewal. Stored messages are preserved.
cancelTerms: Canceling renewal preserves current access until {date} and removes a scheduled future reduction. Stored messages remain available for reading and export to authorized users.
managementPending: An operation is pending. Refresh status reads back the same operation; it does not start another charge.

managementResult.scheduled: The reduction was confirmed for the next renewal.
managementResult.pending: The operation is awaiting confirmation. Refresh status to check again.
managementResult.expired: The operation ended without applying the change. Refresh before starting another.
managementResult.error: The operation could not be confirmed. Refresh status; do not start another charge.

resourcesAllowanceBody: Current allowances per mailbox. Sending counts recipients within the operational cycle; messages and drafts use storage.
planChoiceHint: Choose storage and allowance per mailbox. Mailbox quantity is set during purchase; people and agents use the same plan.
planLocked: This purchase has already started. Its plan and terms are preserved; resume the same purchase.
selectedPlanAllowance: {storage} and {messages, number} recipients per mailbox / cycle. Mailbox quantity is chosen in the next step.
pendingOfferUnavailable: A purchase is in progress, but its plan and quantity could not yet be confirmed. Refresh the status before continuing; do not start another purchase.
